description: Scale-out planner: P&L, ROI, and cumulative P&L for each partial exit level. Edge cases: entry_price and total_size above zero; 2 to 10 exits, each price above zero and pct above 0 and at most 100, the pct values summing to at most 100 (less than 100 leaves the rest open); fees are fractions from 0 to 0.05. Not covered: the remainder not sold, funding, slippage, and the chance that each level is reached. Use when user wants to take profit at multiple targets: "close 30% at $90k, 30% at $95k, 40% at $100k, what's my total P&L?". Returns: per-level pnl, weightedAvgExitPrice, totalRoi.

contractType.description: linear = USDT-margined (default), inverse = coin-margined. total_size is USD notional (contracts) for inverse, and per-level pnl comes back denominated in the base coin.

exits.description: Partial exit levels (2 to 10). Each: { price, pct }, e.g. [{ "price": 90000, "pct": 30 }, { "price": 95000, "pct": 70 }]; the pct values must not sum to more than 100.

total_size.description: Total position size in base currency
